decisions.reason: The modular plant concept already reports quantified customer savings above aspiration, and the growing firm has slack to develop it further, so there is no shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.

The slow-speed shredder sits close to the core offer and has its own web page, so its results likely meet the firm's past-performance aspiration and dropping it would only disrupt the established business.
As a flagship multi-model line that matches the strategic direction toward modular solutions, early uncertainty is carried by organisational slack in a growing industry rather than cut.
The trommel screen extends a core product category with low incremental risk, and nothing signals performance below aspiration, so the firm keeps it.
